descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tax Jr. Analyst is responsible for assisting with basic tax-related tasks, including data entry, document preparation, and administrative support. This role works under close supervision and follows established procedures. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities Indirect Tax Compliance
• Prepare, analyze, and file indirect tax returns (U.S. Sales & Use Tax, Canada GST/HST, and VAT in South America), ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.
• Use automation tools such as Vertex Returns and Avalara, reconciling information against accounting records (SAP/Dynamics), accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
• Set up and maintain new tax jurisdictions as needed, including system configuration/parameterization.
• Manage the electronic filing of returns and payments, as well as manual preparation when automation is unavailable.
• Prepare property tax renditions and coordinate payment requests.
• Manage annual tax license renewals, ensuring timely compliance. Stakeholder Management
• Address internal and external inquiries related to indirect taxes (tax rate determination, taxability criteria, etc.).
• Support audit processes by compiling, validating, and providing required information.
• Maintain, analyze, and cleanse customer records, tax reports, and supporting documentation (exemption/resale certificates, export evidence, among others).
• Collaborate with finance, legal, and operations teams to ensure tax compliance and process improvements. Profile Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in Mexican VAT (knowledge of U.S., Canada, and/or South America is a plus).
• Experience with tax automation tools (Vertex and Avalara highly preferred).
• Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP and/or Dynamics.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, reconciliations, data analysis).
• Intermediate to advanced English level (B1/B2+) for professional communication.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
• Good communication and teamwork abilities. What we offer you
• Benefits Over law
• Saving found
• Training
• Christmas bonus over low
• Development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
